blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Motorists face another steep oil price increase this week, with diesel prices potentially rising by as much as P8.80 per liter. The Department of Energy (DOE) said price hikes will take effect Tuesday morning with diesel up by P8.82 per liter; kerosene by P6.47 per liter; and gasoline by P4.88 per liter. With the latest adjustments, diesel prices will have increased by P18.31 per liter over the past three weeks, while kerosene prices will have risen by P16.67 and gasoline by P15.25 per liter.
